This notice does not relicense ALB or programs written by SDK users.

Version-locked offline toolchains
---------------------------------

The following compiler and runtime toolchains are included for reproducible
offline builds. Their binaries remain under their respective upstream licenses.
Use of these tools to compile user programs does not change the license of the
user's source code. Where an upstream runtime-library exception applies, it is
governed by the upstream license text included in the component or listed below.

deps\fasm                   FASM 1.73.35
deps\asm6f                  asm6f 1.6 fork
deps\NASM                   NASM 3.02rc13
deps\w64devkit              w64devkit 2.6.0 / GCC 15.2.0 / MinGW-w64
deps\gnat_native_15.2.1    GNAT native toolchain 15.2.0
deps\gprbuild_25.0.1       GPRbuild 25.0.0
deps\node                   Node.js 24.21.0 and TypeScript 6.0.3
deps\dotnet                 Microsoft .NET SDK 10.0.400
deps\graalvm                GraalVM Community Edition for JDK 25.0.2
deps\python                 CPython 3.14.2

External Microsoft C++ Build Tools
----------------------------------

Microsoft Visual Studio Build Tools and MSVC compiler binaries are not
included in this SDK and are not redistributed by Oliver Softworks.

Features that specifically require MSVC, including GraalVM Native Image on
Windows, require a user-installed Microsoft C++ Build Tools or Visual Studio
2022 (or newer) installation. `bin\alb.exe doctor` checks for a system
`vcvars64.bat`; when none is found it reports Microsoft's official download
page. `ALB_VCVARS64` or `ALBJ_VCVARS64` may point to a nonstandard
`vcvars64.bat` installation:

  https://visualstudio.microsoft.com/visual-cpp-build-tools/

Microsoft C/C++ runtime DLLs that are present inside unmodified upstream
.NET, GraalVM, and CPython distributions remain part of those components and
are covered by their bundled licenses and notices. They are not the Visual
Studio Build Tools compiler toolchain.

Any use of Microsoft Visual Studio, MSVC, or Build Tools is governed directly
by the user's applicable Microsoft license.
